device.ramp-down.effect.note: Ramp Down coil of the A-14918 Ramp Lifting Mechanism: the retained table has no object for it, so the position is the tip of callout 11's wedge, at the same spot on the lifting ramp's rails as callout 10's; accurate to about 0.04.

device.ramp-up.effect.note: Ramp Up coil of the A-14918 Ramp Lifting Mechanism under the lifting ramp: the retained table has no object for it, so the position is the tip of callout 10's wedge, which meets callout 11's at one spot on the lifting ramp's rails; accurate to about 0.04.

switch.matrix-16.sensor.note: Right Trough: the retained table models the trough in software (cvpmTrough), so no table object marks the switch; the drawing prints balloon 16 without a leader on the trough bar under the apron, at its right (ball-release) end, so the balloon centre is the switch position to the accuracy of the drawing, about 0.04.

switch.matrix-17.sensor.note: Center Trough: the retained table models the trough in software, so no table object marks the switch; the drawing prints balloon 17 without a leader on the trough bar under the apron, between 16 and 18, so the balloon centre is the switch position to about 0.04.

switch.matrix-18.sensor.note: Left Trough: the retained table models the trough in software, so no table object marks the switch; the drawing prints balloon 18 without a leader on the trough bar under the apron, next to the outhole end, so the balloon centre is the switch position to about 0.04.

switch.matrix-54.sensor.note: Up/Down Ramp (Ramp Down switch): the retained script sets it from the ramp's solenoid callbacks with no table object, so the position is the tip of callout 54's leader on the drawing, at the lifting ramp, accurate to about 0.04.
